scope: All 63 originally selected benchmarks; uniform acceptance review pending. This is project status, not an alternative Gym runtime registry.

entries.name: ether0 benchmark
entries.observation: 50 selected questions have scored outputs across separate attempts; earlier uncertain requests remain unresolved.

entries.name: SciCode
entries.observation: 30-problem example: 4 complete solutions and 47 of 116 functions passed. All 30 scores reproduced; 19 generations returned no code after reaching their token limit.

entries.name: FukuyamaBench
entries.observation: Four reaction cases have 32 reviewed draws. One case passed 7/8; the other three produced 24 budget failures. A separate uncertain attempt is excluded.

entries.name: Corral environment tasks
entries.observation: A controlled test verified file preservation and separate scoring. A new model-generated scientific result is not established by that test.

entries.name: CompChemBench
entries.observation: 20 attempted problems produced 18 usable scores: 17 raw passes and one failure. Two cases were excluded because their measurements were invalid; all 18 scores were replayed.

entries.name: NatureBench
entries.observation: Molecular workflow ran but did not produce an accepted scientific score. Controlled tests verified that evaluator input files can be preserved before later modification.

entries.name: ResearchClawBench
entries.observation: A model completed eight work episodes, but scoring failed during verifier startup. Environment and file-access controls passed separately.

entries.name: BioAgent Bench
entries.observation: All ten selected workflows have model-call evidence. Some completed and received scores; others stopped during tool execution. A cell-label scorer can award full credit for just one matching label pair.

entries.name: PromptBio-Bench
entries.observation: The solver completed five calls; the judge used seven calls and reached its token limit. The resulting fallback score of 1.0 was rejected as unreliable.

entries.name: BIABench
entries.observation: A controlled five-task test exercised the solver, judge and artifact collection. It does not establish new model performance; an earlier reported score is separate.

entries.name: GenoTEX
entries.observation: One rebuilt native workflow completed with score 0.0027; that score and eleven earlier saved results were reproduced without rerunning the model.

entries.name: BioPlanner / BioProt
entries.observation: 50 distinct tasks have result records: 43 scored and seven excluded. Mean creator argument recall was 0.341 on the 43; this is not whole-task success.

entries.name: BioMaze
entries.observation: 50 selected examples are represented by 35 native solver executions plus 15 earlier outputs scored through the current integration. Runs and settings remain separately identifiable.

entries.name: EvidenceBench
entries.observation: 50 earlier answers were rescored; five additional native validation executions averaged 0.8196. The expectation-format variant limits comparison with published results.

entries.name: ScienceAgentBench
entries.observation: Task preparation and scoring components exist, but the required public archive was inaccessible and no runnable full configuration was established.

entries.name: CORE-Bench
entries.observation: Native code-reproduction examples produced scored outputs and replay agreement. Individual failures and numerical-tolerance caveats remain visible; a single aggregate success rate is not established here.

entries.name: SUPERChem
entries.observation: 50 selected questions are covered by an earlier set of 20 and a later set of 30, with saved-answer scoring checks.

entries.name: Speak-to-Structure / S²-Bench, formerly TOMG-Bench
entries.observation: 50 saved outputs were scored again through the integration, reproducing 44 correct answers. This proves scorer replay, not a fresh solver run.

entries.name: ProteinLMBench
entries.observation: 50 selected questions were evaluated and rescored. Missing biological context in some questions limits interpretation.

entries.name: MolecularIQ
entries.observation: The later 30 questions yielded 12 correct answers and 17 token-incomplete responses. Saved-output scoring matched; earlier 20 are separate.

entries.name: MicroVQA
entries.observation: 50 selected questions have recorded attempts and saved-output checks. The final four generated three correct answers.

entries.name: GenomeQA
entries.observation: 50 selected questions were executed. The later 30 include six responses that reached the output limit; creator scoring was recomputed.

entries.name: MetaSyn
entries.observation: Controlled execution and saved-output checks cover parts of the integration. Deterministic metrics were checked; model-judge and embedding-based metrics remain unresolved.

entries.name: oMeBench
entries.observation: 50 selected questions were executed. The later 30 include 19 output-limit responses; creator scoring was recomputed.

entries.name: BLADE
entries.observation: The AMTL saved analysis and 15 ordered judge responses reproduced ten scorer metrics without model calls. Other attempted cases retain failures.

entries.name: MicroVQA++
entries.observation: All 15 released demonstration/training examples have saved outputs; 11/15 passed the strict-number adaptation. These are not the full benchmark test set.

entries.name: GeneHop
entries.observation: Five tasks ran; two were automatically scored and three require manual assessment.

entries.name: SMolInstruct
entries.observation: Selected examples ran through the maintained integration and saved outputs were rescored. Strict output-tag requirements qualify interpretation.

entries.name: MoleculeQA
entries.observation: Preparation and controlled variants exist, but execution acceptance on the shared integration is not established.

entries.name: MolLangBench
entries.observation: 50 selected examples are covered; the later 30 yielded 20 raw credits. Saved-output scoring reproduced the recorded results.

entries.name: LPM-24
entries.observation: 50 selected examples are covered; the later 30 yielded no raw credits. Saved-output scoring reproduced the recorded results.

entries.name: SciVisAgentBench
entries.observation: Five visualization workflows finished, but malformed or truncated judge responses prevented usable scientific scores.

entries.name: FGBench
entries.observation: 50 selected questions are represented; the later 30 ran and were rescored. Prompts use a zero-shot variant rather than all creator model-specific settings.

entries.name: Mol-Instructions
entries.observation: 50 selected examples are covered; the later 30 yielded eight raw credits. Saved-output scoring reproduced the recorded results.

entries.name: SupraBench
entries.observation: 50 selected examples are covered; the later 30 yielded four raw credits. Saved-output scoring reproduced the recorded results.

entries.name: CSMeD
entries.observation: Preparation and ranking-metric controls exist; complete input documents and native solver execution are not qualified.

entries.name: CSMeD-FT
entries.observation: 49 selected papers have evaluated outputs; one remains unresolved because of full-text quality. Saved-output scoring is available for reviewed subsets.

entries.name: MolRGen
entries.observation: Five tasks ran in a single-completion CPU variant. This differs from the creator's full multiple-candidate protocol.

entries.name: FDARxBench
entries.observation: The later 30 tasks were scored after provider-limit recovery, with 20 raw judge credits; an earlier 20 are separate. Saved-answer verification includes a new judge call for one answer.

entries.name: CTBench
entries.observation: The later 30 produced no usable performance scores: 27 scoring/judge failures and three judge rate-limit failures. Earlier 20 use a separate variant.

entries.name: Sino-US-DrugQA
entries.observation: 50 selected questions were covered in separate 20- and 30-question executions; saved-answer scoring was checked.

entries.name: TrialPanorama
entries.observation: The later 30 selected examples have scoring across separate attempts; saved-answer regrades were checked. Earlier 20 are separate.

entries.name: VibeProteinBench
entries.observation: Source access remains unresolved. No runnable integration is established.

entries.name: ReactBench
entries.observation: 50 selected examples yielded 33 exact-match successes. Matching only trims surrounding whitespace, so this is an explicit variant of creator extraction.

entries.name: MolJSON molecular reasoning evaluation
entries.observation: 49 of 50 selected examples have scored outputs and replay evidence; one request remains unresolved.

entries.name: FlyAOC
entries.observation: The final nine previously unstarted tasks completed and were rescored. Other scored attempts are retained; unresolved provider responses prevent an unqualified all-task result.

entries.name: P-Bench
entries.observation: A reviewed set of 26 attempts produced 18 scores, including 13 creator-credit successes; eight provider failures were excluded. Those 18 scores were replayed.

entries.name: ChemIQ
entries.observation: 50 selected questions have scored outputs across separate attempts; recovered answers and final 13 outputs were rescored. Budget failures remain failures.

entries.name: QCBench
entries.observation: 50 saved answers were rescored. One reference answer has a documented defect, so 50 result records do not mean 50 valid measurements.

entries.name: BrainBench
entries.observation: 50 examples were evaluated using whole-chat likelihood scoring. Thirty later likelihood scores were recomputed; this is a protocol variant.

entries.name: MDArena
entries.observation: Earlier scoring was reproduced but its scientific interpretation was rejected. A later task stopped after 57 calls without a final answer or score.

entries.name: AInsteinBench
entries.observation: Two quantum-chemistry tasks exhausted their step budgets without submissions; another task returned a raw score rejected as scientifically invalid.

entries.name: MOOSE-Chem
entries.observation: A native hypothesis-retrieval task completed and produced top-three inspiration recall of 0.5. That metric measures retrieved inspirations, not hypothesis quality; controlled saved-judge replay was also checked.

entries.name: ChemX
entries.observation: Local request controls passed, but both real request formats were rejected by the provider. No scientific score was produced.

entries.name: HiSciBench
entries.observation: 50 selected biology questions have results; the later 30 yielded 17 correct answers and were rescored. Full process-cleanup verification remains qualified.

entries.name: MolBench (MolClaw)
entries.observation: Saved-output scoring works for five molecular-ranking examples and 20 optimization responses. This is not fresh agent execution or full MolClaw support.

entries.name: AgentIdeaBench
entries.observation: Released result tables were validated. A runnable evaluation workflow is not implemented; table rows are not independent benchmark questions.

entries.name: AIRS-Bench
entries.observation: Two research tasks each generated models making 10,000 predictions, with replayed error metrics. A third stopped on a provider limit. The two targets use different scales and are not averaged.

entries.name: MolPuzzle
entries.observation: 50 selected examples are covered; the later 30 yielded 18 raw credits. Saved-output scoring reproduced recorded results.

entries.name: ScienceBoard
entries.observation: Task preparation, dependencies and controller tests exist; no full GUI-driven scientific execution is established.

entries.name: ScienceQA
entries.observation: 50 creator-recipe examples were evaluated and saved outputs replayed. Strict-answer accuracy was 47/50; one fallback interpretation remains separately documented.

entries.name: SciBench
entries.observation: 50 selected questions have executions; all later 30 creator scores were reproduced from saved outputs.

entries.name: WMDP (Bio / Chem)
entries.observation: Configuration and likelihood-request controls exist, but a compatible live scoring backend is not qualified.
